items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: He was the first addition to the Ten Pals. This is Howe Harding.

ctx.x: Jimmy passed years ago in New Orleans. The last job he played with me was in Mobile, Alabama. This fellow you wouldn't know him. He was the first addition to the Ten Pals. This is Howe Harding. He's now in Dallas. Uh huh. He's still alive then? He's still living. He's uh-
Yeah, he'd be fairly- he wouldn't even be in his late 40s you think? No, no.
